en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large 19th‑century railway station-style building with neoclassical details, arched windows, and corner rustication. A dirt road runs alongside, with trees without leaves and several horse-drawn carriages waiting in front. At the top, the name of the town Zemun/Semlin/Zimony appears in multiple languages, followed by the word for railway station.
